newsitem.title: USA: 3D SYSTEMS SAYS EOS STAKE DEAL MAY BE OFF.
newsitem.headline: 3D SYSTEMS SAYS EOS STAKE DEAL MAY BE OFF.

text.p: 3D Systems Corp said its agreement to buy a majority interest in EOS GmbH, a major European supplier of rapid prototyping systems in Europe, may be off.
The agreement may be off since an EOS' minority shareholder had exercised his pre-emptive right to acquire the 75.1 percent of EOS' stock it does not currently own, 3D said.

Last month, 3D said it signed an agreement to buy the majority interest in EOS from Carl Zeiss Jena GmbH of Germany, a member of the Carl Zeiss Group, subject to the expiration of the minority investor's pre-emptive right to acquire the majority interest.
3D said it would complete the transaction with Zeiss if the minority shareholder were unable to complete the deal.

On the assumption that the minority shareholder would acquire the 75.1 percent stake, 3D Systems signed a non-binding letter of intent to buy EOS' stereolithography rapid prototyping business, subject to negotiation of a definitive agreement.
No assurance can be given that this transaction will close, 3D said.
Company officials were not immediately available for further comment.
